This is the fast sweep's best hardware cell (29.56 IN-SAMPLE on the metal's fit set, 12.6 over the kill even there); the spec cell (PHI 60, raxis(2.74, -116.6), s 0.70, psi0 -45) reads ideal 12.4 / hardware 41.15 frozen exact.

Ideal: why_ws {'': 298, 'parts': 5, 'contact': 14, 'j3stop': 6, 'fold': 37} (hub-2 burials under the acromion at relayed stretched poses); 7 overhead clip frames are contacts (follow 0.9364).
note: Convergence gate (fast hardware cells after the strap march fix, in order; IN-SAMPLE bench, farm closed, <= 2 local processes): n 26, gain over the 2nd half 0.156 pts, over the last third 0.0 pts, top-5 spread 0.156 pts -> PASSED; the kill does not rest on it: the best in-sample hardware cell 29.56 is 12.6 over the 17.0 kill on the metal's own fit set, and the torso losses (about 10 % of poses across the whole arc) floor any arm-fixed race here. Strap gate on the q_band 0.95 build (step 0). Ideal Bench(60,160) 4.65 is in-sample (not a claim). th margin min 5.001 on every taken pose (window 29.79-104.89, 0 below 5). Near-touch: ideal 17.17 (1 mm) / 32.91 (2 mm); hardware 43.84 / 116.55. T5: ideal 21 contacts / 113.54 mm vs the lead's 4 / 20.24. Not run: continuity flood (dead before it matters: the flood can only drop relayed poses), held-out (untouched), per-pose zero-return margin. Modelling fixes (measured): band fitted per POSE (a pose with other skin over any band ray leaves the fit and is lost), strap from hub 3's plate rim, strap march end t1 300 (the kit's default 220 left the strap's distal 20 mm unfitted - every earlier hardware entry is marked SUPERSEDED), strap floor only away from the end ramps. Shoulder slip: standing price (p95 4.83 / max 5.14 mm at 3 mm GH offset; ~6.4/6.9 mm at R10 4 mm; 13-31 N vs 5 N); assumed a 3 mm liner under the saddle.
